comments.purpose: Patient-free field map for public GEO series GSE176307 in A_BASELINE_BIO.
comments.source_objects: Hashes are null pending coordinator retrieval and hashing.
comments.identity: GEO title contains a patient code; suffixes may distinguish repeated sequencing records, which require review.
comments.visit: GEO has no explicit sample timepoint characteristic. Pretreatment status is supported by the primary study context and published cohort reviews.
comments.response: Use raw GEO io.response as the only located per-sample response label. Preserve NA as unknown; no author patient-level BOR table was located.
comments.expression: Use the author-submitted GEO log-transformed normalized RNA-seq matrix. Feature identifier system is UNKNOWN from inspected processing text; do not infer from annotation wording.
comments.limitations: Prior immunotherapy history and individual biopsy date are not established from the inspected public metadata.

biological_compartment.evidence: Published methods: eligible advanced urothelial cancer patients had archived FFPE tumour tissue from a primary or metastatic site.

treatment.agent: Varies by patient: pembrolizumab, atezolizumab, nivolumab, durvalumab, or avelumab (GEO io.therapy).
treatment.trial: No prospective trial named; retrospective single-center real-world cohort.
treatment.prior_immunotherapy: UNKNOWN; io.lot denotes ICI treatment line but the inspected sources do not establish prior ICI exposure per patient.

corroboration_note.primary_article: Study-level response outcomes and RECIST criteria; no located patient-level crosswalk.

log_transformed_expression.unit: log-transformed filtered read counts; exact scale after centering/scaling not further specified
log_transformed_expression.annotation: Ensembl protein-coding annotation; filtered gene set reported as 16,901

evidence.feature_identifier_system: UNKNOWN: GEO processing text says Ensemble protein-coding annotation but does not identify matrix row key type.
evidence.negative_values: UNKNOWN: median-centering of the deposited BACI file is unverified

log_transformed_expression.evidence: GEO family titles and deposited matrix row identifiers; repeated patient profiles require review.

items.question: Keep prior ICI UNKNOWN unless the source documents it.
The GEO processing statement describes 16,901 genes while the matrix has 16,383 feature columns; review the source discrepancy without remapping.
Review whether the duplicated patient/sample records correspond to one profile; the available matrix row does not establish a tie rule.
